findings.title: Reject nonexact metadata before invoking publish
findings.mechanism: Generic kit verification accepts and reports paragraph apostrophe normalization, then publishes. Coordinator calls kit publish without a mandatory exact inspect gate and checks normalizations only after the irreversible publish action returns.
findings.repair_required: Same-known-ID complete exact metadata/files with an empty normalization list must be enforced before any publish POST, including the verifier actually used for the mutation; mandatory exact inspect state and zero-POST negative controls. Canonicalizing current description alone is insufficient. Preserve known-ID reconciliation and read-only published-state handling.
